footer.tagline: A sport performance laboratory in Chamonix. We turn training and lab data into analysis you can act on.

seo.home: Enduraw analyses endurance training and lab data: a dashboard for runners, lab testing in Chamonix, coaching and conferences.
seo.media: Race analyses, articles and studies by Enduraw on trail running, marathon and endurance performance.
seo.dashboard: The Enduraw dashboard analyses every session synced from Strava, builds your Runner Matrix and race pacing plans.
seo.services: Lab testing in Chamonix, individual coaching and conferences: Enduraw's services for athletes, teams and companies.
seo.lab: VO2max, ventilatory threshold and running economy tests, optional lactate, at the Enduraw Performance Center in Chamonix. Also a venue for camps, seminars and recordings.
seo.coaching: Season-long individual coaching by Enduraw's sport scientists, for every level.
seo.conferences: Talks and workshops on endurance performance and sport data, for companies, schools and events.
seo.about: Who we are: Enduraw, a team of engineers and sport scientists based in Chamonix.
seo.careers: Join Enduraw: open positions and spontaneous applications.
